settings.heading:
A little crunch.
A lot of character.
settings.intro: Sweet, savoury, and full of personality. PapaCorn brings nine flavours to the snack moments you make your own.
settings.story_copy: A movie on the sofa. A pause at your desk. A weekend with your favourite people. There is a PapaCorn flavour for whatever the moment feels like.
settings.story_copy_2: From Choc Corn and Butter Scotch to Cheese, BBQ, and Hot & Spicy, our range makes room for sweet cravings and savoury moods. Pick your favourite, or mix a few and find a new one.
settings.closing_copy: Choose the flavours and quantities you like. Every PapaCorn bag is 50g, at PKR 150 each.
